result_scope: For the exact rank-three frame with one arbitrary cap-one non-infinitesimal physical coordinate of leverage ell in [0,1] and three orthogonal centered-uniform diffuse banks completing covariance I_3, for every spectral orientation u the zero-density converges to a limit at most 3sqrt(2). The proof uses cap-one square-Laplace domination and an exact completely-monotone Gaussian cone kernel. This is not a finite-row uniform bound, does not rule out finite-m overshoot, and is not the full QFORM theorem.

exact_control.statement: Two equal heavy centered-unit-interval rows on the negative eigendirection with two diffuse positive banks have limiting zero-density -2+2e^-3+2sqrt(3pi)erf(sqrt(3))=4.1516968595129935...<3sqrt(2).

partner_result_applied.use: Its exact six-variable peak 4.063070616806037... is the finite benchmark, and its one-coordinate fragmentation barrier rules out repeating a single-coordinate fragment optimization around the cross geometry; this run attacks the complementary mixed-leverage mechanism.

prior_worker_result_extended.relation: The prior theorem excludes probabilistically infinitesimal growing shared frames; the new theorem treats a canonical non-infinitesimal one-row macroscopic core plus diffuse residual, exactly the prior next-step branch.

critical_premises: Bathtub rearrangement for a symmetric decreasing one-dimensional kernel under density cap one.
Elementary erf envelope proved by derivative comparison using log(1+t)<=t.
Exact Gaussian cone delta representation for q=z1^2+z2^2-z3^2.
Standard local CLT for normalized sums of centered unit intervals, used only in the explicit diffuse banks.
unresolved_implication: Determine whether two or more non-collinear macroscopic rows with coordinated cap-one laws can exceed 3sqrt(2), or prove a multivariate analogue of the square-Laplace/cone-kernel domination. Finite-m overshoot, growing nonorthogonal patterns, additional spectral directions, and off-zero peaks remain open.
next_step: Build a two-heavy non-collinear exact rank-three frame with diffuse covariance completion; derive the conditional cone kernel as a positive transform of the two heavy coordinates and optimize over cap-one product laws, using the partner finite benchmark as a control.
